blurb: Sumac Ridge Estate Winery was the first operating estate winery in British Columbia, founded in 1979 in Summerland, Okanagan Valley. They produce quality wines from BC grown grapes, including crisp whites and luscious reds. Guests can enjoy wine tastings and food pairings at the winery, which has been recognized for passion, innovation, and quality.
